mapper.sql: ni.id, ni.instance_id, ni.node_seq, ni.node_code, ni.node_name, ni.node_key, ni.dept_id, ni.decision_mode, ni.pass_threshold, ni.approver_ids_json, ni.status, ni.returned_count, ni.supplement_requested, ni.add_sign_chain_json, ni.started_at, ni.finished_at, ni.created_at, ni.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY ni.node_seq ASC, IFNULL(ni.dept_id, 0) ASC, ni.id ASC
SELECT FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND ni.status IN ('pending', 'active', 'waiting_supplement', 'returned') ORDER BY ni.node_seq ASC, IFNULL(ni.dept_id, 0) ASC, ni.id ASC
SELECT FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND ni.node_seq < #{seq} AND ni.status = 'approved' ORDER BY ni.node_seq DESC, ni.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND ni.status = 'returned' ORDER BY ni.node_seq DESC, ni.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_node_instance (instance_id, node_seq, node_code, node_name, node_key, dept_id, decision_mode, pass_threshold, approver_ids_json, status, returned_count, supplement_requested, add_sign_chain_json, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeSeq}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{nodeKey}, #{deptId}, #{decisionMode}, #{passThreshold}, #{approverIdsJson}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'pending'), IFNULL(#{returnedCount}, 0), IFNULL(#{supplementRequested}, 0), #{addSignChainJson}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_node_instance SET status = 'active', started_at = NOW(), finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_node_instance SET status = #{status}, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_node_instance SET status = 'waiting_supplement', supplement_requested = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_node_instance SET status = 'active', finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_node_instance SET status = 'pending', returned_count = 0, supplement_requested = 0, add_sign_chain_json = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
